name: JoJo's Diner
source:
"Welcome to JoJo's Diner! How may we help you?"

Year 21XX, somewhere deep in space, at JoJo's Diner. You (protagonist nameable) are working your usual shift alongside a bot named Vev, just waiting for the rush hour, when two individuals with a broken ship engine stumble in. Do you want to stay where you are or do you want to explore space? And what is "home" actually?

[From [url=https://qbstudios.itch.io/jojos-diner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“欢迎来到JoJo's Diner！有什么可以帮你的吗？”

21XX年，太空深处的某个地方，JoJo的餐厅。你（主角名字）正在和一个名叫Vev的机器人一起按平常的班次工作，就在等待高峰时间，这时两个带着坏船引擎的人跌跌撞撞地进来了。你想留在原地还是想探索太空？而“家”究竟是什么？

[来自[url=https://qbstudios.itch.io/jojos-diner]itch.io[/url]]
